qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Flavour and taste systems represent <2-4% of customer COGS but define product taste profiles and brand integrity, creating high switching costs. Demonstrated pricing power across the 2021-2023 inflationary spike while expanding margins; operating tangible ROIC exceeds 34%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Peak-to-Peak Compounding, REJECT). Sticky B2B taste and nutrition formulation moat with solid FCF conversion (~89%), but decades of continuous bolt-on M&A have saddled the balance sheet with €5.4B of goodwill, permanently depressing reported GAAP ROIC to 9.6% (median) and capping 4-year Owner EPS CAGR at 3.75%.
qualitative.evidence: Tangible operating ROIC is excellent at 34%-39%, but multi-decade acquisition rollups have accumulated €5.4B of goodwill and intangibles on €5.9B of equity, driving reported GAAP ROIC to 8.7%-9.8% (median 9.65%). 4-year Owner EPS CAGR is sluggish at 3.75% (Owner EPS was €3.88 in 2022 and €4.28 in 2025, dipping from €4.33 in 2024). Net debt of €2.14B is manageable (3.2x net income, interest coverage 9.6x), but chronic sub-10% GAAP ROIC and weak EPS compounding fail Pillar 1 of Gate 6.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
